newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MPC debt papers rated CIB2 plus.
newsitem.headline: MPC debt papers rated CIB2 plus.

text.p: The Philippine private rating agency Credit Information Bureau Inc has given above average rating of CIB2 plus to the planned one-billion peso short term commercial papers of holding firm Metro Pacific Corp (MPC), documents from the Securities and Exchange Commission showed.
"This rating indicates above average capability for payment of commercial paper issues to include both interest and principal," the SEC papers said.
The debt papers mature in a year, the SEC said.
The CIBI rating was based on the projected cashflow and ongoing and completed expansion projects and new investments of the firm, the SEC said.
The CIBI also took into consideration MPC's alternative funding sources, investment prospects and, strategic alliances with foreign partners, the SEC added.
MPC, which has interests in telecommunications, property development, banking and distribution, is a unit of Hong Kong's First Pacific Co Ltd.
